```{r, message=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(DESeq2)
library(data.table)
library(pheatmap)
library(umap)

result_folder = paste("./Results",format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d"),sep="/")
if (!file.exists(result_folder)) dir.create(result_folder, recursive=T)

```


```{r}
bartfeld_folder = ".."
human_data = fread(cmd = paste0("zcat ",file.path(bartfeld_folder,"Raw_counts/GSE127938_human_gastro_organoids_read_counts.txt.gz") ) )
bartfeld_mat = as.matrix(human_data[,3:ncol(human_data)])
rownames(bartfeld_mat) = human_data$V1

load("./GSE127938_human_RNASeq.Rdata")

ed = human_col_anno

gene_anno = human_gene_anno
```

# DGE

```{r}

included_genes = (apply(bartfeld_mat,1,max) > 1 )# & rownames(comb_mat) # %in% tf_in_ds$Geneid) # & (substr(rownames(count_mat),1,1)!="_")

all_results = list()


ed$condition2 = ifelse(ed$tissue %in% c("stomach corpus", "stomach pylorus"), "stomach", ifelse(ed$tissue %in% c("colon"), "large intestine", "small intestine"))

dds_selected = DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = bartfeld_mat, colData = ed, design = ~ condition2)

dds_selected <- DESeq(dds_selected, fitType="local")

############################################
# Stomach vs. caudal
############################################

res <- results(dds_selected, contrast=c("condition2","stomach","large intestine"))
all_results[["Stomach_vs_LI"]] = res


############################################
# Stomach vs. cranial intestine
############################################

res <- results(dds_selected, contrast=c("condition2","stomach","small intestine"))
all_results[["Stomach_vs_SI"]] = res


############################################
# cranial vs. caudal intestine
############################################

res <- results(dds_selected, contrast=c("condition2","small intestine", "large intestine"))
all_results[["SI_vs_LI"]] = res

excluded_genes = names(included_genes[!included_genes])
cols_in_res_table = colnames(all_results[[1]])
empty_cols = do.call(cbind, Map(function(x) rep(NA, length(excluded_genes)), cols_in_res_table ))
excluded_gene_tab = data.frame(row.names = excluded_genes, empty_cols )

for (n in names(all_results)) {
  tmp = all_results[[n]]
  resOrdered <- data.frame(tmp[order(tmp$pvalue),])
  resOrdered = rbind(resOrdered, excluded_gene_tab)
  resOrdered$padj = ifelse(is.na(resOrdered$padj),1,resOrdered$padj)
  res_annotated = as.data.frame(merge(resOrdered, gene_anno[,c("GeneSymbol"), drop=F], by.x=0, by.y=0, sort=F))
  #res_annotated = as.data.frame(merge(resOrdered, gene_anno[,c("Geneid","GeneName")], by.x=0, by.y="Geneid", sort=F))
  res_annotated = merge(res_annotated, bartfeld_mat, by.x="Row.names",by.y=0, all.x=T, sort=F)
  all_results[[n]] = res_annotated
}

normalized = assay(vst(dds_selected))
save(all_results, normalized, ed, file=file.path(result_folder, "Bartfeld_DGE_all.Rdata"))
```



```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
##################################################################
# Volcanos 
##################################################################

all_target_conditions = names(all_results)
par(mfrow=c(1,3))
for (tc in all_target_conditions) {
  r = all_results[[tc]]
  plot(r$log2FoldChange, -log10(r$padj),xlab="log2 Fold Change",ylab="-log10(adj. p-val)", ylim=c(0,max(2,max(-log10(r$padj),na.rm=T))), pch=20)
  title(main=tc, sub=paste("(",nrow(subset(r, padj < 0.05))," signif. DE genes)",sep="") )
  abline(h=-log10(0.05),col="red")
  abline(v=c(-1,1), lty=2)
}

```
